payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over previous state-of-the-art systems in implicit discourse relation classification, including percentage increases in F1-scores.

claims.text: The model improves the macro-average F1-score by over 7% compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The paragraph-level model achieves a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%, outperforming previous models by more than 2% and the best previous system by 1%.
The model shows significant improvements of 6 points on Comparison and 7 points on Temporal relations compared to the best previous systems.
